## 3. High-Tech Equipment & Clinical Technology

### 1. Philips Zoom! WhiteSpeed (Zoom 4) Professional Teeth Whitening
- **Manufacturer**: Philips Oral Healthcare (USA / Netherlands)
- **Technology**: Advanced cold LED light spectrum activation without incandescent heating
- **Clinical Efficacy**: Whitens teeth by up to 6 to 8 shades in a single 45-minute clinical appointment
- **Safety Profile**: Zero thermal pulp damage, zero enamel demineralization
- **Desensitization Protection**: Post-treatment Relief ACP (Amorphous Calcium Phosphate) application remineralizes tooth enamel and eliminates post-operative temperature sensitivity

### 2. Shining 3D IntraoralScan 3.7 Digital Optical Scanner
- **Workstation**: High-speed digital cart paired with Apple silicon processing
- **Functionality**: Complete full-arch 3D digital impressions captured in under 2 minutes
- **Patient Advantage**: Eliminates nauseating impression paste, alginate powders, and gagging reflexes
- **Clinical Accuracy**: Micron-level margin accuracy for CAD/CAM crowns, E-max veneers, MegaGen surgical guides, and orthodontic clear aligners

### 3. MegaGen Biocompatible Titanium Implant Systems
- **Origin**: South Korea (MegaGen AnyRidge & AnyOne systems)
- **Biological Coating**: XPEED nano-structured calcium titanate surface promoting accelerated osseointegration
- **Success Rate**: Clinically proven 99.5% long-term integration rate
- **Warranty**: Official lifetime manufacturer warranty on fixture stability
- **Surgical Duration**: 15 to 20 minutes per implant site using minimally invasive flapless/micro-incision techniques

## 4. Comprehensive Clinical Specialties & Protocols

### 1. Dental Implantation
- Replaces single, multiple, or completely missing teeth without adjacent tooth grinding.
- Flapless guided surgery ensuring minimal tissue trauma, zero post-op swelling, and immediate stability.
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/dental-implant/

### 2. Orthodontics & Bite Alignment (Damon System Braces)
- Self-ligating low-friction metal brackets, sapphire clear brackets, and aesthetic ceramic braces.
- Corrects severe crowding, diastema, deep bites, and crossbites with physiological gentle forces.
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/breketlar/

### 3. CAD/CAM Monolithic Zirconia & Ceramic Crowns
- German and Japanese high-translucency Zirconia and IPS e.max lithium disilicate.
- 100% metal-free biocompatibility; never produces dark gingival margins or galvanic sensations.
- 10-year official warranty.
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/sirkon-keramika-karonkalar/

### 4. Aesthetic E-max Porcelain Veneers (Hollywood Smile Design)
- Ultra-thin 0.3 mm to 0.5 mm porcelain laminates bonded to anterior enamel.
- Resolves severe discoloration, enamel fluorosis, micro-fractures, and aesthetic gaps.
- Preserves 90%+ of natural tooth enamel structure.
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/vinirlar/

### 5. Removable & Fixed Prosthodontics (Dentures)
- Flexible Valplast nylon, precision clasp-retained cast byugel dentures, and acrylic dentures.
- Restores masticatory efficiency, facial height, and phonetics in partial or complete edentulism.
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/pratezlar/

### 6. Clear Orthodontic Aligners (Invisible Trays)
- Serial transparent medical-grade polyurethane trays planned via 3D digital simulation.
- Removable during meals and meetings; 100% invisible in day-to-day conversation.
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/elaynerlar/

### 7. Clinical In-Office Teeth Whitening (Philips Zoom! 4)
- 45-minute treatment under safe cold LED illumination with immediate 6-8 shade enhancement.
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/tish-oqartirish/

### 8. Painless Restorative Dentistry & Endodontics
- Fast relief from acute pulpitis, deep caries, and broken restorations.
- Two-stage numbing protocol: topical strawberry analgesic gel followed by precision micro-anesthetic injection.
- Nano-hybrid composite restorations using 3M Filtek (Germany) and Tokuyama Estelite (Japan).
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/ogriqsiz-tish-davolash/

### 9. Atraumatic Oral Surgery & Wisdom Teeth Removal
- Piezosurgical and gentle luxation removal of impacted third molars and retained roots without bone destruction.
- URL: https://drozodbek.uz/services/ogriqsiz-tish-olish/
